title: 和朋友商量见面的时间与地点
subtitle: Making a simple plan without translating every word

audio.title: Organising a group project
audio.note: 使用音频 0:00–1:15。已实际打开来源页并播放，核验完整音频时长为 1分49.59秒，且页面 Transcript 与原音匹配。今天只听前 75 秒；完整 Transcript 在来源页的 Transcript 标签中，第一遍不要展开。

sections.title: 1. 无字幕先听｜找出大家都有空的时间（4分钟）
sections.body:
播放来源页音频 0:00–1:15，第一遍不要展开 Transcript。不中断、不倒退，也不要在脑中逐词翻译；只判断三个人是在取消活动、安排见面，还是讨论考试结果。

第二遍只抓时间词和同意/不同意信号：this week、mornings、before ten、Wednesday、three till five、four o'clock。

第三遍完成两道主旨题，再估计第一次无字幕听懂比例。答完后才看精听提示。第三方原文仅短提示一句：“When are you free?”
questions: 三个人为什么想先见一次面？
他们最后在周三几点都有空？
sections.answers:
1. They want to meet first to plan what they are going to do for the group project.
2. They are all free at four o'clock on Wednesday.

sections.title: 2. 精听辨音＋连读弱读（5分钟）
sections.body:
每处按“先听两遍 → 看短句 → 模仿两遍 → 关文字重听”练习。

① Do you want to start this week?｜Do you 常连得接近 /dəjə/；want to 常压缩成 /wɒnə/，重音在 start、week。
② How about we meet first?｜How_about 会自然连接；about 中间音节较弱，meet first 更清楚。
③ When are you free?｜When_are 连读，are 常弱读 /ə/；重音落在 free。

最后把文字关掉，重听 0:00–1:15，并跟读一遍你最清楚的意群。不要追每个小词，只模仿重音和停顿。
questions: Do you 在自然语流中可能听起来接近什么？
When are you free? 中哪个词承担主要重音？

sections.title: 3. 原创阅读｜把模糊邀约变成明确计划（4分钟）
sections.body: On Friday afternoon, Maya messaged two friends about studying together at the weekend. Leo was free on Saturday morning, but Nina had a driving lesson before lunch. Instead of ending the conversation, Nina suggested Sunday afternoon. Maya checked her calendar and said that three o'clock worked for her. Leo agreed, but they still needed a place. The public library was quiet, yet they could not discuss their project there. Maya suggested a café nearby with large tables and free water. Everyone liked the idea. They confirmed Sunday at three and agreed to stay for one hour. Maya also wrote down one goal: finish the first part of their presentation. Making the plan took only a few short messages. Nobody used perfect sentences, but each person clearly said when they were free, offered another option and confirmed the final time and place.
questions: Why didn't they choose the public library?
What final time, place and goal did they agree on?
sections.translation: 周五下午，玛雅给两位朋友发消息，商量周末一起学习。利奥周六上午有空，但妮娜午饭前要上驾驶课。妮娜没有结束对话，而是建议周日下午。玛雅查看日历后说三点适合她。利奥同意了，但他们仍需要确定地点。公共图书馆很安静，可是他们不能在那里讨论项目。玛雅建议去附近一家有大桌子和免费饮用水的咖啡馆。大家都喜欢这个主意。他们确认周日下午三点见，并约定待一个小时。玛雅还写下一个目标：完成演示文稿的第一部分。整个计划只用了几条短消息。没人使用完美句子，但每个人都清楚说明了自己何时有空、提出了替代方案，并确认最终时间和地点。
sections.answers:
1. Because they could not discuss their project there.
2. They agreed to meet at a nearby café at three o'clock on Sunday and finish the first part of their presentation.

sections.title: 4. 词汇与高频词块｜提出、调整并确认计划（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. Are you free on ...?｜你……有空吗？｜Are you free on Sunday afternoon? 你周日下午有空吗？
2. How about ...?｜……怎么样？｜How about meeting at three? 三点见怎么样？
3. That works for me.｜那个时间/安排适合我。｜Sunday works for me. 周日我可以。
4. I can do ...｜我……有空。｜I can do four o'clock. 我四点可以。
5. Where shall we meet?｜我们在哪里见？｜Where shall we meet after lunch? 午饭后我们在哪里见？
6. Let's meet at ...｜我们在……见吧。｜Let's meet at the café. 我们在咖啡馆见吧。
7. See you then.｜到时见。｜Great, see you then! 好的，到时见！
8. available｜有空的、可用的｜I'm available after three. 我三点以后有空。
9. nearby｜附近的｜There's a quiet café nearby. 附近有一家安静的咖啡馆。
sections.answers: 优先记住 7 个词块：Are you free on ...? / How about ...? / That works for me. / I can do ... / Where shall we meet? / Let's meet at ... / See you then.

sections.title: 5. 语法｜How about + -ing 与 Shall we + 动词原形（3分钟）
sections.body:
用 How about + 动词-ing 提建议；用 Shall we + 动词原形邀请对方一起做某事。不要说 How about meet，也不要说 Shall we meeting。

例句 1：How about meeting at four? 四点见怎么样？
例句 2：Shall we meet at the café? 我们在咖啡馆见好吗？
questions: 改错：Shall we meeting near the library?
sections.answers:
1. meeting
2. Shall we meet near the library?

sections.title: 6. 原创对话＋替换＋快速回应（3分钟）
sections.body:
原创双人对话
A: Are you free on Saturday afternoon?
B: Sorry, I have a driving lesson. How about Sunday?
A: Sunday works for me. I can do three o'clock.
B: Great. Where shall we meet?
A: Let's meet at the café near the library.
B: Perfect. See you then.

替换练习
① Saturday afternoon → Friday evening / Sunday morning；driving lesson → family lunch / gym class。
② three o'clock → half past four；café near the library → park by the station。

快速回应：3 秒内开口。
1) 对方问周六是否有空，但你没空。→ Sorry, I'm busy. How about Sunday?
2) 对方建议周日下午三点。→ That works for me.
3) 时间定了，还没定地点。→ Where shall we meet?

30–60 秒口头任务：约朋友见面，说明一个不能去的时间，提出替代日期，确认具体时间与地点，最后说 See you then。不要先把整段中文写出来。
sections.answers: 示例：Hi, are you free on Saturday afternoon? I'm busy in the morning, but I can do three o'clock. How about meeting at the café near the station? We can stay for an hour. Does that work for you? Great, see you then.

sections.title: 7. 前课复习＋反馈（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习昨天 3 个词块，并接到今天的邀约：
1. Let me introduce myself.｜让我自我介绍一下。
2. We have a lot in common.｜我们有很多共同点。
3. keep in touch｜保持联系。

快速串联：Let me introduce myself. We both like photography, so we have a lot in common. Let's keep in touch. Are you free on Sunday?

请回原聊天告诉我：① 第一次无字幕听懂了约百分之多少；② 最卡的是哪一句；③ 用英文文字或语音完成 30–60 秒邀约任务。只有实际收到并分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 完成标准：能不看文字说出 3 个复习词块，并完成“询问是否有空＋替代时间＋确认地点”的短对话。
